Q6097.reason: In most states, 'to A and the heirs of his body' creates a fee simple absolute, so the cousin took all and the later deed gave the niece nothing.

Q5137.reason: A physician may give a medical opinion from x-rays he personally read; FRE 703 does not require those facts to be in evidence first, and the best-evidence rule is misstated by D.

Q5526.reason: Only the late-evening break-in of the guest's hotel room has common-law breaking, entry, dwelling, nighttime, and intent to commit a felony (forcible collection of a debt).
